answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a $5 bond and must do paid work with 8 distinct counterparties from the shared lagoon within a 10-epoch horizon. Closed-loop trades score zero, so sock puppets trading only with each other never qualify. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x ($5 + 8 x $3) = $29,000, and each failed check doubles the bond in a cost spiral. An honest agent pays once and keeps its rewards whole.
